Accountable obligation owner.value: Owns the quarterly solicitation supervision cycle for the Japan entity and the international roll-up; escalates to the Head of Compliance and to the Compliance Officer of the Japan branch/subsidiary who signs the Art. 100-2 internal-control attestation

Citation verified against current regula.value: Yes — e-Gov Japanese Law Translation text of Insurance Business Act Art. 115 (price fluctuation reserve), Art. 116 (policy reserve) and Art. 117 (outstanding claims reserve) as cited in the register, re-read at cycle open; the operative solicitation duties tested here sit at Art. 100-2 (proper business operation), Art. 294 / 294-2 / 294-3 (information provision, intention ascertainment, intention confirmation), Art. 300 and 300-2 (prohibited solicitation acts and FIEA-deemed rules for variable annuities) plus FSA Comprehensive Supervisory Guidelines II-4 and the Principles for Customer-Oriented Business Conduct — the mismatch between the register's reserve citations and this item's sales-supervision subject is logged as an open register defect for Regulatory Counsel

In-scope processes.value: Variable annuity and all-lines solicitation performed by tied agencies, bank-assurance branches and direct sales staff: intention ascertainment → product proposal and suitability assessment → pre-contract document delivery (契約概要 / 注意喚起情報) → intention confirmation → application acceptance → post-sale confirmation call; supervision covers Japan plus every international selling entity consolidated into the annual FSA business report

In-scope systems.value: Policy Administration Platform is the source of record for the solicitation population (application date, producer code, channel, product, premium, funding source); Genesys Cloud holds the recorded post-sale confirmation calls, the agency/producer management system holds registration status, and sampled case files sit in the document management repository

Compliance procedure documented.value: Solicitation Supervision & Sample Testing Procedure (募集管理態勢) v-current — channel scope, risk-based sample sizing, the eight solicitation test attributes (registration, intention ascertainment, suitability, disclosure delivery timing, intention confirmation, prohibited acts, bank-channel non-coercion, post-sale confirmation), producer scoring bands and the retraining/clawback ladder

Compliance procedure approved.value: Approved by the Head of Compliance and noted by the Japan entity Board's Compliance Committee; re-approved annually before the Q1 cycle and immediately on any FSA supervisory-guideline amendment or Life Insurance Association solicitation-guidance update

Filing/reporting deadlines tracked.value: Quarterly supervision report due to the Compliance Committee within 30 calendar days of quarter end (Q1 30 Jul, Q2 30 Oct, Q3 30 Jan, Q4 30 Apr); the four quarters feed the solicitation-management section of the annual business report filed with the FSA within 3 months of the 31 March business-year end, i.e. by 30 June

Deadline reminders configured.value: GRC platform workflow fires at quarter-end minus 10 business days (population extract), quarter-end plus 10 business days (sampling complete), plus 20 (findings issued) and plus 30 (report to committee); a 15 May reminder opens the annual business-report data pack

Evidence retained per the retention requ.value: Supervision report, population extract, sample selection log, per-case test sheets, recorded-call references and remediation records retained 10 years from the policy's termination, matching the Japan solicitation-record retention expectation and the entity's tax/statutory book retention

Violations/exceptions logged with dispos.value: Each failed attribute is raised as a solicitation-conduct issue with producer code, policy number, article breached (e.g. Art. 294-2 intention record missing, Art. 300(1)(i) misrepresentation) and a disposition of retraining, commission clawback, solicitation suspension, or FSA/Local Finance Bureau notification where systemic

Remediation sign-off captured.value: Signs each quarter's remediation closure pack; Regulatory Counsel co-signs any case escalated to an FSA voluntary notification or a policy reinstatement/cancellation remedy

Test population (in-scope transactions,.value: All new-business applications accepted in the quarter across every solicitation channel, split by product family with variable annuity and bank-channel cases carried as separate strata; plus all in-quarter complaints, cooling-off withdrawals and policies lapsed or surrendered within 13 months

Pass/fail thresholds.value: Attribute pass rate ≥ 98% overall; zero tolerance on Art. 300 prohibited acts, missing suitability record for a variable annuity sale and unregistered solicitor — any single instance fails the quarter; a producer with ≥ 2 failed cases or a 13-month early-lapse rate above 5% is placed under enhanced monitoring

Compliance test frequency matched to the.value: Supervision sample testing runs quarterly against that quarter's solicitation population; results aggregate to the annual solicitation-management assessment supporting the 30 June business report, so the register's Quarterly item frequency and Annual derived frequency are both discharged

Independent reviewer (segregated from th.value: Reviewer must sit outside Distribution and outside the Market Conduct testing team, and must not have supervised, trained or scored any producer in the sample

Evidence location for test results.value: Quarterly Solicitation Supervision workpaper (population extract, seeded sample log, per-case attribute sheets, call-recording references, exception register, producer scorecards) filed in the compliance evidence repository under Japan / Market Conduct / <FY><Quarter>

Regulator-ready documentation.value: Four quarterly supervision reports, the producer scorecard set, the exception register with dispositions and the solicitation-management procedure, assembled into an FSA on-site inspection pack (検査資料) in Japanese and English within 5 business days of a Local Finance Bureau request

Regulator response path.value: Market Conduct / Consumer Compliance Manager drafts responses to FSA / Kanto Local Finance Bureau inquiries and Life Insurance Association enquiries; Regulatory Counsel clears every response and any Art. 128 report-order answer or voluntary notification before it leaves the entity, with the Head of Compliance informing the Board

checklist.step: Open the quarterly cycle and fix the solicitation channel scope
actions: In the GRC platform open Controls ▸ Solicitation Supervision and create the cycle record for the quarter (FY<yyyy>-Q<n>), setting the population window to the quarter's application-received dates.

Ask the Distribution Operations Manager for the current channel register and copy in every active channel: tied agency (専属代理店), independent agency, bank-assurance branch, worksite, direct/call-centre and any international selling entity consolidated into the FSA business report.
Mark variable annuity and bank-channel cases as mandatory separate strata, because they carry the FIEA-deemed conduct rules applied through Insurance Business Act Art. 300-2.
Record any channel excluded from testing with the written reason and the approving manager — an unexplained exclusion is itself a finding.
Set the cycle milestone dates: extract at quarter-end minus 10 business days, sampling complete +10, findings issued +20, committee report +30.
checklist.done: the cycle record lists every active channel with strata flags, dated milestones, and a written reason for each excluded channel.

checklist.step: Verify every solicitor in scope is currently registered and appointed
actions: Export from the agency/producer management system every producer code with a solicitation in the quarter, with registration number, registration type (役員・使用人 notification vs registered agency), appointment start/end dates and the entities they may solicit for.
Reconcile the export to the Life Insurance Association solicitor registration records and to the Local Finance Bureau notification list held by Legal Operations, matching on registration number.
Flag any producer whose solicitation date falls outside their appointment window or whose registration lapsed, expired or was suspended mid-quarter.

Send the flagged list to the Distribution Operations Manager the same day and hold every flagged policy for case review — an unregistered solicitation breaches Art. 275/276 and cannot be cured by paperwork.
Save the reconciliation as producer-registration-recon-<FY><Q>.xlsx in the cycle folder.
checklist.done: every producer with an in-quarter solicitation is matched to a live registration covering that date, or is on the flagged list with policies held.

checklist.step: Extract the solicitation population from the policy administration system
actions: Run the New Business ▸ Applications Accepted extract for the quarter, returning policy number, application date, product code and product family, premium mode and amount, single-premium flag, channel, producer code, branch, customer age, and funding source (maturing deposit, loan proceeds, existing policy surrender).
Join the billing/commission platform commission register on producer code and policy number so a sale that paid commission but is missing from the application extract cannot hide.
Add the 13-month early-lapse and cooling-off withdrawal flags from the persistency report and the in-quarter complaint list from the Complaints Manager.
Reconcile the extract row count and premium total to the quarter's new-business production report and clear any variance greater than 0.5% before releasing the file.
Publish the reconciled extract to the cycle folder as population-<FY><Q>.csv with the row count and reconciliation note in the header.
checklist.done: the population file is reconciled to the new-business production report within 0.5% and carries channel, product, producer, age, funding source and lapse/complaint flags.

checklist.step: Draw the risk-based sample and record the method so it can be re-drawn
actions: Take 100% of: variable annuity sales to customers aged 70 and over, sales funded from loan proceeds at a bank branch, cases with an in-quarter complaint, cooling-off withdrawal or lapse inside 13 months, and cases by any producer under enhanced monitoring.

Draw a seeded random sample from the remainder stratified by channel — minimum 25 cases per channel or 5% of channel volume, whichever is larger — using RANDBETWEEN over a sorted, row-numbered population with the seed written into the sheet.
Record population size, per-stratum counts, seed value, selection date and selector name on the Sample Log tab.
Issue the case list to the Annuity Suitability Analyst and the reviewing Compliance Analysts with the per-case attribute sheet template attached.
Store the workbook as sample-log-<FY><Q>.xlsx in the cycle folder.
checklist.done: the sample covers 100% of the mandatory strata, meets the per-channel minimum, and is reproducible from the recorded seed and population file.

checklist.step: Assemble the case file and the recorded evidence for each sampled sale
actions: For each sampled policy pull from the document management repository: the application form, the intention ascertainment sheet (意向把握シート), the suitability/customer profile record, the signed intention confirmation sheet (意向確認書), the delivered 契約概要 and 注意喚起情報, and for variable annuities the prospectus receipt and market-risk explanation acknowledgement.
In Genesys Cloud search the post-sale confirmation call by policy number or customer phone and note the recording id, call date and duration on the case sheet.
Pull the DocuSign completion certificate for e-signed packs to obtain the exact delivery and signature timestamps.
Where any document is missing, request it once from the branch with a 3-business-day deadline; if it is still absent, mark the attribute FAIL for absence of record rather than pending.
Attach every retrieved artefact to the case sheet and lock the case sheet header (policy, producer, channel, product, tester, retrieval date).
checklist.done: each sampled case has a locked case sheet with its documents, DocuSign timestamps and call-recording id attached, or a recorded FAIL for absence.

checklist.step: Re-perform the suitability assessment on variable annuity and single-premium cases
actions: Read the customer profile captured at solicitation: age, investment experience, income and financial assets, investment purpose, holding horizon and stated risk tolerance.

Test the recorded profile against the product's risk band and the company suitability matrix — flag single-premium variable annuities sold to customers aged 80+, to customers with no investment experience, or where the premium exceeds 50% of declared liquid financial assets.

Confirm the file evidences that the market-risk, surrender-charge period and minimum-guarantee (最低保証) mechanics were explained, and that the customer's own words on purpose are recorded rather than a ticked template.

Reach an independent suitable / not suitable conclusion before reading the producer's conclusion, then compare; any divergence is an exception under the suitability principle applied through Insurance Business Act Art. 300-2.
Write the conclusion, the matrix cell relied on and the evidence page references onto the case sheet.
checklist.done: every variable annuity and single-premium case carries an independent suitability conclusion with the matrix cell and evidence references, and divergences are raised as exceptions.

checklist.step: Test pre-contract disclosure delivery and its timing
actions: Confirm the 契約概要 (policy outline) and 注意喚起情報 (alert information) versions delivered are the editions current on the application date — compare the document edition code to the Product Compliance edition register.

Check delivery happened before or at the point of application, using the DocuSign completion timestamp or the branch delivery log; delivery dated after the application date is a fail under Art. 294 information-provision duty.

For variable annuities confirm the prospectus (目論見書) and the supplementary explanatory document were delivered and receipted, and that the surrender-charge schedule and fee table pages are the ones in force.
Confirm the customer signature or receipt acknowledgement is present for each document and matches the applicant, not a family member, unless a documented proxy exists.
Record delivered / not delivered, edition code and timestamp per document on the case sheet.
checklist.done: each case shows the correct in-force editions delivered on or before the application date with a matched customer receipt, or a dated fail.

checklist.step: Test intention ascertainment and intention confirmation records
actions: Read the intention ascertainment sheet and confirm it captures the customer's own objective (protection, retirement income, inheritance/succession, asset accumulation) before any product was proposed, as required by Art. 294-2.
Trace the proposed product back to that stated objective and confirm the file explains why this product answers it; a proposal that pre-dates the ascertainment record is an exception.

Confirm the intention confirmation sheet (意向確認書) under Art. 294-3 is signed at application, lists the material terms actually chosen (rider set, payment period, annuity option) and shows any gap between initial intention and final contract explained in writing.
Where a comparison against other companies' products was shown, confirm the comparison document is a company-approved version and is complete rather than selectively favourable.
Record pass/fail per attribute with the page reference on the case sheet.
checklist.done: every case evidences intention ascertained before proposal and confirmed at application, with any intention-to-contract gap explained in writing.

checklist.step: Screen the sampled sales for prohibited solicitation acts
actions: Play the post-sale confirmation recording in Genesys Cloud and listen for the Art. 300 prohibited acts: false statements about policy terms, failing to disclose or inducing non-disclosure of material facts, inducing an unfavourable switch from an existing policy, misleading comparative statements, assertive statements about uncertain future returns, and offering special benefits (特別利益の提供) such as premium rebates or gifts.

For switch/replacement cases pull the surrendered policy's values and confirm the file documents the disadvantage disclosure and the customer's acknowledgement of surrender charges and lost guarantees.
Check the commission register in the billing/commission platform for any non-standard payment, gift-card expense or entertainment claim tied to the sampled policy.
Record any suspected prohibited act with the recording id, the timestamp within the call and a verbatim transcript excerpt, and refer it to Regulatory Counsel the same day.
Treat any confirmed instance as an automatic quarter fail under the zero-tolerance threshold.
checklist.done: every sampled case is screened against the Art. 300 list with call evidence cited, and confirmed instances are referred to Regulatory Counsel.

checklist.step: Test the bank-assurance channel controls on loan-linked and deposit-funded sales
actions: For every bank-branch case confirm the non-coercion (非強制) explanation was given and receipted — that the insurance purchase does not affect lending decisions and that the bank acts as agent, not insurer.

Where the customer is a borrower of the bank, confirm the sale was made by a solicitor separated from the lending decision and that the borrower-sales restriction (融資先販売規制) exemption relied on is named on the file.
For deposit-funded sales confirm the file records that the customer was told the product is not a deposit, is not covered by deposit insurance, and carries principal loss risk.
Reconcile the branch's declared solicitation-responsible-person (募集責任者) assignment for the quarter against the branch roster held by the Distribution Operations Manager.
Log each bank-channel attribute pass/fail on the case sheet and summarise by branch.
checklist.done: each bank-channel case evidences non-coercion, non-deposit and separation-of-lending controls, with the responsible-person assignment reconciled per branch.

checklist.step: Cross-read complaints, cooling-off and early lapses against the sampled producers
actions: Extract from the case management tool every in-quarter complaint coded to solicitation conduct, mis-explanation or unwanted contact, with policy number and producer code.
Compute the 13-month early-lapse rate and the cooling-off withdrawal rate per producer from the persistency extract, and flag producers above 5% early lapse or above 3% cooling-off.
Overlay the flagged producers onto the sample and add any flagged producer not already sampled as a mandatory extra case.
Read the complaint narrative against the sampled case sheet for the same producer and note where the complaint corroborates a tested attribute failure.
Hand the corroborated list to the Market Conduct / Consumer Compliance Manager for the findings pack.
checklist.done: complaint, cooling-off and early-lapse data is joined to producer scores and every flagged producer appears in the tested sample.

checklist.step: Score producers, issue findings and set the remediation ladder
actions: Roll the per-case attribute results into a producer scorecard: cases tested, attributes failed, weighted score and band (Green / Watch / Enhanced monitoring / Suspension).

Issue a written finding to each affected producer and their branch manager within 20 business days of quarter end, stating the policy number, attribute, article breached and the required corrective action.

Apply the ladder: single documentation failure → targeted coaching; repeat or suitability failure → mandatory retraining plus 100% pre-issue review of that producer's next quarter; prohibited act or unregistered solicitation → immediate solicitation suspension and commission clawback via the billing/commission platform.

Where the customer was harmed, open a remediation case with Customer Service for policy reinstatement, cancellation with premium refund or a corrective explanation visit, and record the customer outcome.
Load every action into the GRC platform with an owner and a due date inside the next quarter.
checklist.done: every failed case has a written finding, a ladder action with owner and due date, and any customer-harm remedy is recorded with its outcome.

checklist.step: Deliver the mandated retraining and evidence completion
actions: Assign in the learning management system the module matching each failure type — suitability for variable annuities, pre-contract disclosure, intention ascertainment, Art. 300 prohibited acts, or bank-channel non-coercion.
Set the completion deadline to 30 calendar days from the finding date and require a pass mark of 80% on the end-of-module assessment.
Chase non-completers weekly through the branch manager and escalate any producer still incomplete at day 30 to the Producer Compliance Manager for solicitation suspension.
Export completion certificates with producer code, module, completion date and score into the cycle folder as retraining-evidence-<FY><Q>.pdf.
checklist.done: every mandated retraining is completed with a recorded score, or the producer is suspended, with certificates filed in the cycle folder.

checklist.step: Clear the prior quarter's open items before closing this cycle
actions: Open the prior cycle record in the GRC platform and list every action still in Open or In-progress status with its owner and original due date.
For each, obtain the completion evidence (retraining certificate, clawback journal reference, reinstated policy number, revised procedure section) and attach it to the action before closing.
Re-test one case per closed action from the current quarter's population for the same producer and attribute, to prove the fix held rather than trusting the closure note.
Escalate any action more than 30 days past due to the Head of Compliance with a written recovery plan.
checklist.done: no prior-quarter action closes without attached evidence and a re-tested case, and every overdue action has an escalated recovery plan.

checklist.step: Report to the Compliance Committee and feed the annual FSA business report
actions: Issue the quarterly supervision report within 30 calendar days of quarter end covering population and sample sizes, attribute pass rates against the 98% threshold, zero-tolerance breaches, producer band movements, complaint and early-lapse trends, and open remediation.
Table it at the Compliance Committee and the Japan entity Board, and minute the discussion and any Board-directed action.

Hand the four-quarter roll-up to the Regulatory Reporting Manager by 15 May so the solicitation-management (募集管理態勢) narrative and figures are in the annual business report filed with the FSA within 3 months of the 31 March business-year end, i.e. by 30 June.
File the full workpaper set into the compliance evidence repository under Japan / Market Conduct / <FY><Q> with the 10-year-from-policy-termination retention label applied.
Confirm the repository index makes the record retrievable by producer code, policy number, branch and attribute.
checklist.done: the quarterly report is minuted at the Committee, the roll-up reaches the 30 June business report, and the workpaper is filed under the 10-year retention label.

testing.step: Rebuild the solicitation population independently and reconcile it to the source of record
actions: Re-run the New Business ▸ Applications Accepted extract for the quarter directly from the Policy Administration Platform without using the compliance team's file, keeping policy number, application date, channel, producer code, product and premium.
Reconcile your row count and premium total to the commission register in the billing/commission platform and to the finance new-business production report, listing every unmatched policy.
Compare your population to population-<FY><Q>.csv and quantify omissions by channel — a channel absent from the tested population is a control gap, not a data issue.
Confirm the international selling entities consolidated into the FSA business report are represented, since the item's scope is International.
testing.done: the independently rebuilt population reconciles to commission and finance records, and every omission from the tested population is quantified by channel.

testing.step: Verify the sample was drawn as the procedure requires and can be re-drawn
actions: Open sample-log-<FY><Q>.xlsx and re-execute the selection using the recorded seed and the population file; confirm you obtain the identical case list.
Check the mandatory strata were taken at 100%: age 70+ variable annuity sales, loan-funded bank-branch sales, complaint/cooling-off/13-month-lapse cases and enhanced-monitoring producers.
Recompute the per-channel minimum (greater of 25 cases or 5% of channel volume) and flag any channel sampled below it.
Treat an unreproducible sample or an under-sampled channel as a control-design exception regardless of the results obtained.
testing.done: the sample re-draws identically from the recorded seed, all mandatory strata are complete, and per-channel minimums are recomputed and met or flagged.

testing.step: Re-perform the suitability judgement on a sub-sample without reading the original conclusion
actions: Select 15 variable annuity cases weighted toward customers aged 75+ and premiums above JPY 10 million.
Read only the customer profile, the product specification and the suitability matrix, and record your own suitable / not suitable conclusion with the matrix cell relied on.
Reveal and compare the Annuity Suitability Analyst's conclusion; count differences, including cases where the answer matched but the matrix cell or evidence reference was wrong.
For each difference, re-read the intention ascertainment sheet to determine whether the profile itself was thin, which points to a solicitation defect rather than a testing defect.
testing.done: each sub-sampled case has a blind re-performed suitability conclusion, and every difference is classified as a testing defect or a solicitation defect.

testing.step: Trace disclosure delivery to independent timestamps rather than the tester's tick
actions: For 20 sampled cases open the DocuSign envelope and read the Certificate of Completion for the sent, viewed and signed timestamps of the 契約概要 and 注意喚起情報.

Compare each timestamp to the application date held in the Policy Administration Platform and recompute the day gap; any document signed after the application date is an Art. 294 failure the test should have caught.
Check the document edition code on the delivered PDF against the Product Compliance edition register in force on the application date.
Where delivery was on paper, inspect the branch delivery log entry and the wet-signed receipt image in the document management repository.
testing.done: delivery timing for each traced case is proven from DocuSign or branch-log evidence, and any timing failure the original test passed is recorded.

testing.step: Independently re-verify solicitor registration for the sampled sales
actions: For every sampled policy look up the producer code in the agency/producer management system and read registration number, registration status and appointment window as at the solicitation date, not as at today.
Cross-check ten of those registration numbers against the Life Insurance Association solicitor registration record and the Local Finance Bureau notification list held by Legal Operations.
Confirm the producer was appointed for the specific writing entity and product class sold — an appointment for one entity does not cover another.
Report any solicitation performed outside a live registration directly to the Head of Compliance and Regulatory Counsel on the day it is found.
testing.done: every sampled solicitation is matched to a live, entity-correct registration at the solicitation date, or reported the same day as a breach.

testing.step: Re-listen to confirmation calls and re-test the prohibited-acts screen
actions: Pull 12 recordings by recording id from Genesys Cloud, biased toward replacement/switch cases and cases with a complaint.

Listen end to end and score against the Art. 300 list: false statements, non-disclosure inducement, disadvantageous switching, misleading comparison, assertive statements about uncertain returns, special benefits.
For switch cases confirm the surrender charge, lost guarantee and new surrender-charge period were spoken aloud and acknowledged, not merely present in the pack.
Compare your scoring to the Market Conduct / Consumer Compliance Manager's screen and record any missed instance with the recording timestamp and a verbatim excerpt.
testing.done: each re-listened call carries an independent Art. 300 score with timestamped excerpts, and every instance missed by the original screen is recorded.

testing.step: Recompute the thresholds, rates and reporting deadlines
actions: Recompute the overall attribute pass rate from the case sheets and compare it to the 98% threshold stated in the report — recompute rather than accept the reported figure.
Recompute each producer's 13-month early-lapse rate and cooling-off withdrawal rate from the persistency extract and confirm the 5% and 3% flags were applied correctly.
Recompute the reporting dates: quarter end + 30 calendar days for the Committee report and 31 March + 3 months (30 June) for the annual FSA business report, and compare to the actual issue dates.
Record any misstated rate or missed deadline as an exception, citing both the reported and recomputed values.
testing.done: pass rate, lapse and cooling-off rates and both reporting deadlines are recomputed, with every variance to the reported figures listed.

testing.step: Test that remediation actually happened rather than merely being logged
actions: Take every ladder action from the prior quarter and pull its evidence: learning management system completion record with score and date, commission clawback journal reference in the billing/commission platform, suspension flag in the agency/producer management system, or customer remedy record.
Confirm suspended producers wrote no new business after the suspension date by querying the current-quarter population for their producer codes.
Confirm each retrained producer's mandated 100% pre-issue review was actually performed on the next quarter's cases by inspecting three of those files.
Treat a closed action with no completion evidence as an open action and re-age it from its original due date.
testing.done: each remediation action is proven by system evidence, suspended producers show zero subsequent sales, and evidence-free closures are reopened at their original age.

testing.step: Log every exception with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise a GRC issue per exception recording policy number, producer code, channel, attribute failed, the Insurance Business Act article engaged and the customer impact.

Assign a root cause from the fixed list — population omission, sampling shortfall, tester judgement error, branch record-keeping failure, producer conduct failure, procedure gap — and name a single accountable owner.
Set a remediation date inside the next quarter and mark every exception as a mandatory retest row in the following cycle.
For systemic findings, open an assessment with Regulatory Counsel on whether a voluntary notification to the Kanto Local Finance Bureau is required and record the reasoned decision either way.
testing.done: every exception carries an issue, a fixed-list root cause, a named owner, a remediation date, a retest commitment and a documented notification decision where systemic.

testing.step: Conclude, obtain independent sign-off and report
actions: Compute the exception rate over the tested sample and state the conclusion — effective / effective with exceptions / ineffective — against the 98% attribute threshold and the zero-tolerance items.

Confirm the signing reviewer sits outside Distribution and the Market Conduct testing team and supervised, trained or scored none of the sampled producers, and record that confirmation in the workpaper.

Report the conclusion, exception rate and any zero-tolerance breach to the Audit Committee and the Japan entity Board at the next sitting, and note whether the finding affects the solicitation-management narrative in the 30 June FSA business report.

File the signed workpaper, population extract, sample log, case sheets and exception register in the compliance evidence repository under Japan / Market Conduct / <FY><Q> with the 10-year retention label.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with a stated conclusion, recomputed exception rate, independence confirmation and Board reporting date exists in the evidence repository.
